analysis: You opened this stretch on 14 July with a rough one — just under six hours — and then promptly swung to nine and a half, which is chaotic and I respect it. The middle of the week found its footing with three nights sitting between seven fifteen and seven fifty-five, which is genuinely solid and shows the ritual stack is doing something real. The back end has slipped a little, with last night clocking nearly an hour and a half of awake time eating into an otherwise decent total, and that creeping restlessness over the last two nights is worth watching. Deep sleep is staying pretty modest across the board — that seventeen-minute average is the one thing the hot shower and yin yoga haven't fully cracked yet, but babe, the consistency you're building in the middle of this window is the whole point.
